title: Flaky CLI packaging test times out under full-suite load
description:
`packages/cli/test/cli.test.ts > package smoke > packs publishable tarballs with
dist output and no source/test files` intermittently fails with
`Test timed out in 10000ms` when run as part of the full Vitest suite, and
passes reliably when its file is run alone.

OBSERVED
2026-09-10/11, on `eshyra-o9bd.19.12` and on `eshyra-o9bd.19.12.2` (a branch
touching only `packages/core/src/discovery` and its tests). Three of five
`npm run verify:worktree` runs failed on it; a plain `npm run test` on the same
tree passed at 5295 passed / 20 skipped, and `npx vitest run
packages/cli/test/cli.test.ts` passed 15/15.

WHY IT MATTERS
It is a false red on the pre-commit gate. An agent that takes it at face value
either burns a cycle chasing an unrelated change or, worse, learns to ignore a
failing gate.

LIKELY CAUSE (unverified)
The test shells out to `npm pack` for both workspaces. Vitest spawns one worker
per file (296 workers observed), so under that load a real `npm pack` can
exceed the declared `timeout: 10_000`. The timeout was presumably sized against
an unloaded run.

CANDIDATE FIXES, in preference order
1. Raise the declared timeout to something that reflects packing two workspaces
   on a loaded machine. Cheapest, and the assertion is about tarball CONTENT,
   not speed — the timeout was never the thing under test.
2. Pack once per suite rather than once per test, if more than one case needs
   the tarball.
3. Only if neither holds: mark the file as needing a dedicated pool.

Do NOT fix it by deleting the assertion or by skipping the test: it guards the
published tarball against shipping source and test files, which is a real
release property.
notes: 2026-09-22 RE-EXAMINED under the 6-worker cap (eshyra-9l5s.2 / PR #552) by eshyra-9l5s.5. VERIFIED CAUSE: worker fan-out contention (default maxWorkers = 20 on this host), per audit docs/audits/test-suite-and-verification/2026-09-14-test-suite-and-verification-audit.md section 2.6. The '296 workers observed' reading was Vitest's per-file spawn count under isolate:true, not concurrency; the over-subscription it inferred was real. EVIDENCE (measured, not 'did not reproduce'): 'packs publishable tarballs...' took 1.43 / 1.55 / 1.55 / 1.45 s in four capped full-suite runs, against its 10 s budget: >=6.4x headroom. Nine capped full-suite runs this session were green. Latest main CI (4-worker cap) passed. DISPOSITION: fixed at the cause by the cap. Candidate fix 1 (raise the timeout) was NOT taken and is not needed; no code change.
close_reason: Cause verified (uncapped worker fan-out) and fixed by the worker cap from eshyra-9l5s.2; pack test measured at 1.43-1.55 s under the capped full suite vs 10 s budget. Evidence in notes (eshyra-9l5s.5).
